run_kb_teacher: run the KBTeacher to load the personalized dialog knowledge base for answering questions
run_full_task_teacher: run the FullTaskTeacher with a specific task ID for personalized dialog training
run_small_task_teacher: run the SmallTaskTeacher with a specific task ID for small-scale personalized dialog training
run_all_full_teacher: run the AllFullTeacher to train on all five full personalized dialog tasks at once
run_all_small_teacher: run the AllSmallTeacher to train on all five small personalized dialog tasks at once
